title: Quaint Peruvian Beef Anticuchos
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring grilled beef heart anticuchos with a sweet and sour yuzu cure, served with crispy bacon lardons and a side of diabetic friendly vegetables. This dish is a comforting and flavorful representation of Peruvian cuisine.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to make the yuzu cure.
Add the beef heart pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill to medium high heat and thread the marinated beef heart pieces onto skewers.
Grill the anticuchos for 5 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to an internal temperature of 160 degrees.
While the anticuchos are cooking, cook the bacon lardons in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Add the red bell pepper and zucchini to the pan and cook until they are tender.
Season the vegetables with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the grilled anticuchos with the crispy bacon lardons and diabetic friendly vegetables.
Drizzle the remaining yuzu cure over the top of the dish and serve immediately.
